newsitem.title: USA: Ill. Superconductor to demonstrate filters.
newsitem.headline: Ill. Superconductor to demonstrate filters.

text.p: Illinois Superconductor Corp said Monday it will demonstrate two new base station filters used for cellular and Personal Communications Services (PCS) networks at a trade show in San Francisco next month.
The filters expand the coverage of rural and suburban cellular base stations by at least 20 percent and cell site range extention by as much as 25 percent, Illinois Superconductor said.
The company develops and markets radio frequency products.
Its shares were trading down 1/4 Monday at 17-1/8.
